paragraphs.source_en: - At 4% your withdrawals equal $40,000 - Your $750,000 in VTSAX earns \~2% dividend, or $15,000 - Your $250,000 in VBTLX earns \~3% interest, or $7,500 - That totals $22,500 and if that’s all you need, you’re done. - But if you want the full $40,000, the remaining $17,500 you’d withdraw by selling shares from your taxable account. Taken monthly it would be \~$1,500.

paragraphs.source_en: As we saw in the last chapter, the Trinity Study set out to determine how much of a portfolio one could spend over decades and still have it survive. Adjusting each year for inflation, withdrawals of 4% annually were found to have a 96% success rate. This became the 4% Rule designed to survive the vast majority of stock downturns so you wouldn’t have to worry about market fluctuations in your retirement.
